# Neo.canvas.Base can only acquire a 2d OffscreenCanvas context

## Context

`Neo.canvas.Base` (`src/canvas/Base.mjs`) is the base class of every renderer that runs in the Canvas Worker. Its class comment promises "Context Management: robust handling of `OffscreenCanvas` transfer and context acquisition via `waitForCanvas`", but the acquisition is one hardcoded call: `me.context = canvas.getContext('2d')` (`src/canvas/Base.mjs:255` at `2d993a26cb`). The `context` member is typed `OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D|null` (`:66`).

Witness (2026-09-24, D#19151 H3-a, canvas-worker arm): a WebGL2 renderer for a 100k-node / 1M-edge scene ran in the engine's canvas worker at 116–120 fps. To get its context it had to override `waitForCanvas` wholesale — the polling loop, the size update, the mounted hook and the loop start were copied for one changed argument. The four in-tree subclasses (`apps/portal/canvas/{Footer,Home,Services,Timeline}Canvas.mjs`) draw with 2d and are not affected by this ticket.

## The Problem

- A renderer that needs any other context (`webgl`, `webgl2`, `bitmaprenderer`) cannot declare it; it re-implements the lifecycle method, which then drifts from the base (the #19125 window-group routing already changed the neighbouring `setTheme` shape).
- WebGL contexts take creation attributes (`alpha`, `antialias`, `powerPreference`, `preserveDrawingBuffer`, `desynchronized`) that exist only at `getContext()` time. There is no later setter, so the acquisition point must carry them.
- `getContext()` returns `null` for an unsupported type. The 2d path never fails, so the base has no null handling: the loop would start against `context === null`, and a subclass that skips the `canRender` guard throws once per frame.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/canvas/Base.mjs:142` `initGraph` → `:250` `waitForCanvas`, which polls `Neo.currentWorker.canvasWindowMap[canvasId]?.[windowId]` (the canvas worker's transferred canvases, `src/worker/Canvas.mjs`), acquires the context (`:255`), calls `updateSize`, the optional `onGraphMounted` hook (`:261`) and starts the render loop.
- The App Worker side (`src/app/SharedCanvas.mjs`, `src/component/Canvas.mjs`) transfers the canvas and calls `initGraph` over the remote; it never sees the context and is untouched.
- Module loading roots (`src/worker/Canvas.mjs#loadModule`) are `#19163` / PR `#19165`'s concern and untouched.
- Static config semantics: a non-reactive config is read once; an `OffscreenCanvas` is bound to its first context type, so a later change cannot re-acquire — the configs are deliberately not reactive.

## The Fix

`src/canvas/Base.mjs` only:

1. `contextType: '2d'` — the `OffscreenCanvas#getContext()` type. Non-reactive: read once when the canvas arrives.
2. `contextAttributes: null` — the second `getContext()` argument (`WebGLContextAttributes` / `CanvasRenderingContext2DSettings`), passed only when set.
3. `waitForCanvas`: `me.context = canvas.getContext(me.contextType, me.contextAttributes || undefined)`. When the result is `null`: one `console.error` naming the class and the type, `context` stays `null`, no `updateSize` / `onGraphMounted`, no loop.
4. The `context` member's JSDoc type widens to the union of the four context interfaces.

Subclasses opt in by static config:

```js
static config = {
    className        : 'Observatory.canvas.Observatory',
    contextType      : 'webgl2',
    contextAttributes: {alpha: false, antialias: false, powerPreference: 'high-performance'}
}
```

Accretion note: this adds two configs and one guard to the base and deletes nothing in-tree — the deletion lands in every non-2d consumer, which no longer overrides a lifecycle method (the witness drops 15 lines for 2). The first in-tree consumer is the observatory renderer named as H3's engine sub on D#19151.

| `Neo.canvas.Base` config `contextAttributes` (new) | same block | second `getContext()` argument when set | `null` → no second argument | JSDoc on the config | AC-1, AC-2 |
| `waitForCanvas` (`:250`) | existing protected method | acquires `getContext(contextType, contextAttributes)`; a `null` result is an error, not a running loop | n/a (2d never returns null) | method JSDoc | AC-3 |
| `context` member (`:66`) | existing member | JSDoc type widens to the four context interfaces | n/a | JSDoc | diff |

## Decision Record impact

`none` — no ADR governs the canvas worker's renderer contract. D#19151 (the witness) is not this ticket's authority and its graduation does not gate it: the change matches no `ideation-sandbox-workflow.md §5.2` high-blast trigger (one file, one substrate, single-PR).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 — a `Neo.canvas.Base` subclass with no override acquires `getContext('2d')` with no attributes argument; the four Portal canvases are not in the diff.
- [ ] AC-2 — a subclass declaring `contextType: 'webgl2'` and `contextAttributes` receives `getContext('webgl2', attributes)`; `context` holds the returned object; `updateSize` and `onGraphMounted` fire as before; the loop starts when `hasChange` is set.
- [ ] AC-3 — a `null` context leaves `context` null, calls neither `onGraphMounted` nor the loop, and logs one error naming the class and the type.
- [ ] AC-4 — `test/playwright/unit/canvas/ContextAcquisition.spec.mjs` covers AC-1..3 with a fake `canvasWindowMap` canvas whose `getContext` records its arguments; AC-2 and AC-3 red at `origin/dev` (the base ignores the configs and starts the loop on null), AC-1 green there as the control.
- [ ] AC-5 (post-merge) — the D#19151 canvas-worker witness drops its `waitForCanvas` override for the two config lines; receipt on D#19151.

## Out of Scope

- Any renderer library, WebGL helpers, or a `Neo.canvas.WebGL` base — H3's engine sub on D#19151 decides that shape after its STEP_BACK.
- Loader roots for workspace builds (`#19163` / PR `#19165`).
- App-Worker-side classes (`app.SharedCanvas`, `component.Canvas`).
- Reactive re-acquisition on config change (impossible on a bound `OffscreenCanvas`).

## Gold Standards Rejected

- **A `createContext(canvas)` method hook.** Imperative for a declarative value; keeps the override pattern this ticket removes.
- **A fallback chain (`webgl2` → `webgl` → `2d`).** A silent downgrade paints the wrong picture with no signal; a subclass names one type and a `null` is an error it can see.
- **Reactive `contextType_`.** An afterSet cannot re-acquire; a reactive config would promise a change it cannot deliver.
